name: Home Price Report
purpose: Calculates sale price per square foot of living area for each neighbourhood and year built

inputs.parcel_id: Parcel number the city uses to identify the property
inputs.sale_price: Price the home sold for, in dollars
inputs.living_area_sqft: Living area above ground, in square feet
inputs.lot_area_sqft: Size of the lot the home sits on, in square feet
inputs.year_built: Year the home was first built
inputs.sale_type: Type of deed or contract the home was sold under, such as warranty deed or contract
inputs.property_tax: Property tax charged on the home each year
